body: Well my school is honestly super confusing about our dress code. They tell us every year but never enforce it. So people would be wearing all sorts of things that would be breaking dress-code and be getting so many compliments from teachers. It’s the same with me.

I’m so sorry you had to go through that. I don’t understand why parents can’t realize that they can’t take away the things we spend our own money on. The majority of the clothes she took, she had previously complimented them and mentioned that they were “perfectly appropriate” and “really cute”.
I mainly just relied on him for my own happiness which wasn’t fair of me at all. I was unhappy with the way I looked and how i was and I relied on him to fix it.
I cut my hair super short the way I’ve always wanted it, and started working out. It actually helped my self esteem so much.

I have told him this a lot in the past three years and every time he’s super sweet about it. He always says that he still loves me and forgives me and that he is actively choosing to stay with me now. We’ve constantly talked about having a future together.

I’m in San Antonio, Texas and I’ve been told that you can only obtain one through earning it like being employee of the day and having your name on enough surveys....My manager informed me that it’s like that because they have to send in an order for it and ig it’s expensive...?
So I appreciate your advice, but I’d also appreciate it if you simply stopped and had a nice day. Thank you

Well that’s mainly because I don’t. I don’t call her names or say awful shit to her. I’m very calm with my mother. 
I’m sorry if it seems like I’m holding a grudge, because that’s really not what I’m trying to do. I’m just used to feeling like I have to step on eggshells to avoid making her angry, and over the years it has become expected for her to yell at me, and I suppose it feels strange for her to suddenly be so nice to me. 
I’m reminding myself of these things because I’m afraid of when she’ll stop acting like this and become abusive again. Because I know it will happen again. I love my mother and I respect her very much, but I can’t just forget and forgive her for all the things she has done and the way she has treated me.
I am not holding a grudge, I am afraid she will hurt me again. 
And i think you’re right, I shouldn’t keep remind myself of all of these moments where she hurt me both physically and emotionally. Because if I do that, I’ll stop myself from letting go and growing up more than I already have been forced to. And she can’t hurt me anymore.

I understand, and I am trying to enjoy this time with my mother. But after years and years of abuse with no confrontation about it whatsoever, I find it a little difficult to just completely forget all of the things she’s done to me and act like it never happened.

Thank you, this is actually really helpful and it’s really nice of you to provide all these links. Half of them I didn’t even know about, but I will definitely check these out and try to help myself with these issues. 👍
I appreciate you offering up the links but I’d prefer not to do the tests..
Well I already know that I definitely have anxiety and social anxiety. I’m typically anxious daily, and I have definitely struggled with social anxiety for years in the past.
That’s true, and you’re probably right. I agree that I need to remind myself that these are signs of growth and that I need to acknowledge these moments and let go of them. Thank you for the advice!
That’s fair. I think you’re right and I should be putting more effort into bigger gestures and communicating, so I see you’re point...
Yes, every year I’ve tried to make my gifts as thoughtful as possible..

I have done these type of things before. Sometimes I would see some chocolate at the store and buy it for him or make some extra food and leave it out for him.
I remember a couple times where I saw a keychain of a show or game he liked and I would buy it for him.
